turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I play music and I'm looking for a laptop for recording at home.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to describe all the options before I hear your opinion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A Mac with a fast chip and a silent fan, which is great for music apps but pricey to upgrade storage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A Windows laptop with lots of ports and a big drive, cheaper, though the fan gets loud under load.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A secondhand pro laptop from a friend, two years old, very powerful, but no warranty at all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So, that's all of them. Tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For recording, a silent machine is a big deal, so the Mac has a real edge. The Windows laptop's loud fan could end up on your tracks. The secondhand one is tempting, as long as you trust your friend and test it well.
